transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you to the clinic?

Well, thank you. I'm here because... well, it's about elevators, mostly. Whenever I step into a slow elevator, or really any small locked room, my chest just jumps right away. I get this really strong need to get back out before I can even think straight. It just hits me immediately, and I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
Have you ever had an episode like this come on unexpectedly when you were not in an elevator or another confined space?

No, not really. It's pretty much just when I'm in those small spaces. If I'm out in the open or just going about my day normally, I don't get that feeling at all. It's just... well, just the elevators and small rooms.
